passive.name: Break the Mold
passive.description: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

spells.name: Shattering Strike
spells.description: Rell thrusts her lance, Stunning targets for seconds, destroying all Shields, and dealing magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
spells.description: Passive - Mounted Alacrity: Rell gains Move Speed while mounted. Active - Ferromancy: Crash Down: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing magic damage. Rell gains Shield, which lasts until she remounts. Rell then enters her armored form, gaining % increased Armor and Magic Resist, % Attack Speed and Attack Range. In this armored form, she can use Ferromancy: Mount Up.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DismountDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Full Tilt
spells.description: Rell and an ally charge, gaining % Move Speed, increased to % when facing enemy champions or each other for seconds. Rell's next Attack or Shattering Strike explodes in an area for max Health magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MaxHealthDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Magnet Storm
spells.description: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies towards herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies towards herself and deals magic damage over the next seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
